title: Fingerprint bucket-mixing repair
motivation: F-AHL32 preserved registry correctness and exact-key reuse, but the amended hash-quality gate failed because direct power-of-two indexing produced a 413-probe worst-case chain at 10000/16384 occupancy.

repair.bucket_index: derive a bucket hash by folding higher fingerprint bits into lower bits before power-of-two masking

frozen_workload: identical F-AHL32 10000-unique plus second-pass exact-key replay
